Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_batch_id VARCHAR2(14);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0210');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 begin
 select max(coll_date) into :ctrl_blk_1.s_coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_coll_date is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Block.Name: COMPONENT_LABEL_OVERRIDES
Block.WhereClause: where unit_id = :unit_id and coll_date = :s_coll_date and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 begin
 select product_desc into :product_desc
 from valid_products
 WHERE product_code = substr(:product_code,1,5) --HCL To make the comparison
 --HCL between base product codes 
 AND unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme; --HCL --HCL base product codes
 exception
 When NO_DATA_FOUND
 then null;
 end;
--
 begin
/* HCL select code_desc into :old_code_desc
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'ABO' and
 code = :old_label_decision; 
*/

/* THE SELECT STATEMENT BELOW HAS BEEN INTRODUCED BY HCL */
 
 SELECT abo_short_name into :old_code_desc
 FROM valid_abo_values
 WHERE abo_label = :old_label_decision
 AND unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme 
 AND (sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL (term_date, sysdate+365)); 

 exception
 When NO_DATA_FOUND
 then null;
 end;
--
 begin
/* HCL select code_desc into :new_code_desc
 from master_codes where
 code_type = 'ABO' and
 code = :new_label_decision;
*/

/* THE SELECT STATEMENT BELOW HAS BEEN INTRODUCED BY HCL */

 SELECT abo_short_name INTO :new_code_desc
 FROM valid_abo_values
 WHERE abo_label = :new_label_decision
 AND unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme 
 AND sysdate between eff_date AND NVL(term_date, sysdate+365); 

 exception
 When NO_DATA_FOUND
 then null;
 end;
--
 begin
 select code_desc into :override_code_desc
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'OVERR' and
 code = :override_code;
 exception
 When NO_DATA_FOUND
 then null;
 end;
--
 begin
 select substr(note,1,60),
 substr(note,61,120),
 substr(note,121,180),
 substr(note,181,240) into
 :note_1,:note_2,:note_3,:note_4
 from note_books
 where note_id = :override_note_id;
 exception
 When NO_DATA_FOUND
 then null;
 end;
end;

begin

 :CTRL_OVERRIDE_DATS := v_local_time;
 else

 end;
